QuestInfo.name: [Daily Quest] Save the Morass
QuestInfo.0:
#bMorass, the Swamp of Memory#k, is where memories gather.
You must stop Morass from sinking until you find the clues needed to reach the next region.

Keep Morass stable by taking on #r3#k missions every day from #b#p3003432:##k in #r#m450006130:##k.

Defend Morass with #b#p3003432:##k so that the Swamp of Memory does not become a memory itself.
